title: Venetian Mask Material Alchemy Workshop
description: A mystical crafting table (coffeemat) serves as your alchemy workbench where a floating Venice mask hovers above it. The user mixes and applies PBR material properties—metalness, roughness, emissive glow, color tint, opacity, and normal intensity—across six mask zones using a conservation-based pigment system with limited total material energy, supporting full undo/redo of every operation.
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap with ES modules from cdn.jsdelivr.net). Load venice_mask.glb as a floating, slowly rotating mask centered above the scene, and coffeemat.glb as a flat workbench surface below it. Use a PerspectiveCamera at (0,2,4) looking at origin, with OrbitControls. Add an HDR-style lighting rig: one warm DirectionalLight, one cool RimLight, and an AmbientLight.

Core mechanic — Material Energy Conservation: The system has exactly 6.0 total 'pigment energy' units shared across 6 mask zones (split the mask mesh into zones by face-index ranges or child meshes). Each zone has 6 PBR sliders: metalness (0-1), roughness (0-1), emissive intensity (0-1), color hue (0-360 mapped to 0-1 cost), opacity (0.2-1.0), and normal scale (0-2 mapped to 0-1 cost). Each slider value consumes energy; the sum across ALL zones and ALL properties must never exceed 6.0. When a user increases one slider, others must be available to decrease elsewhere — enforce this by clamping or blocking increases when budget is exhausted. Display a glowing energy bar on the coffeemat surface using a ShaderMaterial that fills/depletes reactively.

Interaction requirements (10-14 steps): Click a mask zone to select it (highlight with emissive outline). A floating HTML panel shows 6 sliders for that zone. Adjusting any slider updates the zone's MeshPhysicalMaterial in real-time and recalculates global energy. Implement an Undo/Redo stack (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y) storing full snapshots of all zone material states — minimum 20-level deep. Add a 'Randomize Zone' button that respects energy conservation. Add a 'Swap Zones' mode where clicking two zones exchanges their full material configs. The coffeemat workbench should reflect the dominant mask color via an environment-reactive tint on its own material. Show zone index, energy used per zone, and total remaining energy in a HUD. All 6 sliders across any 2+ zones with undo/redo yields 12+ meaningful interaction steps.
